subject: prd/impl-review
statement: If effective depth or pass count falls below FR-24, a zero-pass terminal is attempted, critical passes share lineage or review different revisions, a remediation round is counted as a pass, or one required pass is absent, stale, invalid, non-accepting, or disagrees, then the system shall preserve all evidence, name every violated invariant, and refuse aggregate satisfaction until the complete correctly floored, mutually blind exact-revision set succeeds
intent: non-accepting aggregate with contributing outcomes and exact violations
fit_criterion: floor, zero-pass, single-pass-critical, shared-context, leakage, mismatched-revision, remediation-miscount, missing-pass, and split-verdict fixtures never accept
